renderers.evidence: 3Dmol parser documentation declares cif/mcif and vasp (CONTCAR/POSCAR) support.

limitations: No renderer library is bundled; the Science Lab host must supply a declared compatible renderer.
Mol* compatibility is not claimed because this plugin has not verified a general crystal-CIF integration contract with the host Mol* surface.
POSCAR is emitted only when each OPTIMADE site maps to one fully occupied element; coordinates remain available otherwise.
The CIF adapter preserves the exact file but normalizes only selected scalar fields and deposited asymmetric-unit atom rows; it is not a complete CIF validator and does not expand symmetry.
COD formula search intentionally accepts only a constrained space-separated Hill-style subset. COD has no documented result limit, so result JSON is skipped when the count exceeds maxMatches.
OQMD OPTIMADE extension fields are provider-defined; null values are preserved as null and OQMD pagination links are neither trusted nor followed.

The direct MCP OQMD receipt proves only the returned standalone response. It does not claim immutable Agentlas Science ResearchRun, Source, or artifact persistence; use the host search_materials_structures route for that evidence boundary.
Density is not inferred from formula text or site counts; it is withheld unless composition, formula-units Z, and formula weight are explicit in the normalized source.
